problem: Streamlit dashboard control plane has zero authentication or session access controls
impact: If bound to non-loopback interface arbitrary network users can approve actions or inject faults
recommended_fix: Bind strictly to 127.0.0.1 and add an authenticated reverse proxy (OIDC/OAuth2) for multi-user deployments

problem: Uncaught exceptions during Groq client API calls without try/except or retry logic
impact: Network dropouts or HTTP 429 rate limits crash the application during agent execution
recommended_fix: Wrap Groq API calls in a retry backoff loop and catch exceptions to fall back to offline mode

problem: MAX_RETRIES configuration parameter is defined but never imported or used anywhere
impact: Misleads operators into believing API calls automatically retry on transient failures
recommended_fix: Import MAX_RETRIES in agents.py and implement an exponential backoff loop

problem: SQL filter explicitly requires fault_mode = 'normal' which only exists on local demo service
impact: Prevents training live LSTM model on real external targets because external services return unknown fault mode
recommended_fix: Update query to accept fault_mode IN ('normal' 'unknown') when status_code = 200

problem: No cross-process lease prevents concurrent sampling by both the web UI and worker daemon
impact: Running dashboard and worker simultaneously pollutes database with duplicate sample records
recommended_fix: Implement an inter-process lock or database lease so only one collector process samples at a time

problem: Dashboard displays most recent database row without checking if timestamp is stale
impact: If collector worker stops or crashes hours-old telemetry is presented as current without alert
recommended_fix: Add a staleness check comparing latest sample timestamp to current time and display a warning

problem: LIVE_DATA_GUIDE.md RESEARCH_PLAN.md and OPERATIONS.md referenced in documentation do not exist in repo
impact: Users and reviewers looking for operational and research details encounter broken links
recommended_fix: Commit the missing documentation files or remove references from README and START_HERE

problem: Documented setup command Copy-Item .env.example .env failed out-of-the-box because template was missing
impact: Initial onboarding fails on clean clone until template file is manually created

problem: Static rule guardrails override neural anomaly detection via logical OR gate
impact: Prevents isolating whether incident was detected by the LSTM autoencoder or by simple static if rules
recommended_fix: Log separate model vs rule attribution in evaluation benchmarks and ablation experiments

problem: Calibrating reconstruction threshold at 99th percentile of healthy data produces 1% baseline false positive rate
impact: At 5-second polling intervals a 1% FPR produces ~7 false alarms per hour on normal steady-state systems
recommended_fix: Calibrate threshold at 99.9th percentile or require consecutive anomaly detections across multiple windows

problem: Sliding windows with stride 1 overlap by 95.8% and are shuffled across training minibatches
impact: Artificially inflates effective sample count and introduces high correlation across training batches
recommended_fix: Use non-overlapping strides or evaluate block-bootstrap cross-validation for time-series modeling

problem: Offline agent mode relies entirely on hardcoded string keyword heuristics rather than actual LLM reasoning
impact: Passing unit tests in offline mode does not prove agent generalization or diagnostic capability
recommended_fix: Use recorded LLM prompt/response fixtures for offline integration testing

problem: LLM mode has no runtime validation enforcing that returned action_id belongs to the valid catalog
impact: In LLM mode an unconstrained model can hallucinate an arbitrary action ID outside the valid set
recommended_fix: Add runtime assertion validating that returned action_id is a member of catalog_ids

problem: Approval ticket is marked consumed before remediation HTTP call executes
impact: If network drops or process fails during recovery the ticket is consumed requiring full re-approval
recommended_fix: Implement a two-phase reservation/commit pattern or retry grace period on consumed tickets

problem: Host CPU RAM and Disk metrics describe the collector machine not the monitored remote host
impact: Monitoring a remote service fails to measure target resource exhaustion
recommended_fix: Integrate with remote metric exporters (Prometheus Node Exporter or CloudWatch) for target metrics
